sources.ref: NCERT Class 11 Biology, Ch 10 Cell Cycle and Cell Division (2026-27 reprint)

notes: Images generated with Agnes AI through the visual-director presets, reviewed against the checklist and content-qa. Provenance (prompts, hashes, rounds) is in tools/content-research/media/agnes-log.json. Delivered as WebP (3:2 at 1536x1024); originals kept outside the repo.

requests.brief: three soft green clay balls in a row on a table: a small ball on the left, the same ball grown larger in the middle, and on the right that large ball pinched apart into two equal small balls

alt.en: Three smooth green balls in a row: a small ball on the left, a larger ball in the middle, and on the right two equal balls pressed side by side.
alt.hi: एक पंक्ति में तीन चिकनी हरी गेंदें: बाईं ओर एक छोटी गेंद, बीच में एक बड़ी गेंद, और दाईं ओर दो बराबर गेंदें जो एक-दूसरे से सटी हैं।

requests.brief: two identical green knitted socks hanging side by side from a line, held together at their middles by a single wooden clothes peg
must_show: one peg joining them at the middle

alt.en: Two identical green knitted socks standing side by side, held together at their middles by one wooden clothes peg.
alt.hi: दो एक जैसे हरे बुने हुए मोज़े अगल-बगल खड़े हैं, जिन्हें बीच में एक लकड़ी की चिमटी ने जोड़ रखा है।

requests.brief: a long soft green balloon lying on a table with a ring of ribbon tightened round its middle, pinching it into two equal round halves

alt.en: A long green balloon lying on a table with a pink ring tightened round its middle, pinching it into two equal halves.
alt.hi: मेज़ पर रखा एक लंबा हरा गुब्बारा, जिसके बीच में एक गुलाबी छल्ला कसा है और उसे दो बराबर हिस्सों में दबा रहा है।

requests.brief: a wide green school ground seen from high above: in the exact middle, four pairs of children stand in one straight line running from top to bottom, the two children of each pair holding hands; far away, one teacher stands at the left edge of the ground and one teacher at the right edge, both facing the line
must_show: four pairs of children in one line across the middle
one adult at the far left edge
one adult at the far right edge

alt.en: A wide green ground seen from above: four pairs of children, each pair holding hands, stand in one line down the middle, and one adult stands far off at the left edge and one at the right edge, both facing the line.
alt.hi: ऊपर से दिखता एक चौड़ा हरा मैदान: बच्चों के चार जोड़े, हर जोड़ा हाथ पकड़े, बीच में एक पंक्ति में खड़े हैं, और एक वयस्क बहुत दूर बाएँ किनारे पर तथा एक दाएँ किनारे पर पंक्ति की ओर मुँह करके खड़े हैं।

requests.brief: a shallow square wooden tray seen from directly above; a thin green divider is being slid in across the middle, it already fills the centre of the tray but does not yet reach the left and right sides, leaving a small gap at each end
must_show: a small gap at each end of the divider

alt.en: A shallow square wooden tray seen from above, with a green divider placed across the middle that does not quite reach the two sides.
alt.hi: ऊपर से दिखती एक उथली चौकोर लकड़ी की ट्रे, जिसके बीच में आर-पार एक हरा विभाजक रखा है जो दोनों किनारों तक पूरा नहीं पहुँचता।

requests.brief: two straight thick ropes lying parallel on a table, far apart from each other, one rope green and one rope orange; near the right end the green rope has one short orange band and the orange rope has one short green band, at the same position on both ropes
must_show: a short orange band on the green rope
a short green band on the orange rope at the same place

alt.en: Two straight ropes lying parallel, one green and one orange; near the right end the green rope has a short orange band, and the orange rope ends in a short green piece.
alt.hi: दो सीधी रस्सियाँ समानांतर रखी हैं, एक हरी और एक नारंगी; दाएँ सिरे के पास हरी रस्सी पर एक छोटी नारंगी पट्टी है, और नारंगी रस्सी एक छोटे हरे टुकड़े पर खत्म होती है।

requests.brief: exactly four equal quarter slices of one round green-iced cake, each slice on its own small plate; the four plates are arranged in a square, two plates in front and two plates behind; no whole cake and no cake stand
must_show: four plates in a two by two square

alt.en: Four equal slices of one green-iced cake, each on its own small cream plate, set out in a square of two in front and two behind.
alt.hi: हरी आइसिंग वाले एक केक के चार बराबर टुकड़े, हर एक अपनी छोटी क्रीम रंग की प्लेट पर, आगे दो और पीछे दो के वर्ग में रखे हैं।
